method: Deduplicated union of full/excerpt/searched reads; full takes precedence. Downloaded-only files are not called read. Tests were read as source, never executed.

paper.read: Full HTML sections 1–9, references, appendices A/B; all 13 figure images directly inspected across team

other_limits: Peripheral Scatter regression/fit/connection and chart settings implementations are not fully audited by this agent.
Standard UI availability of MetricCard faceting was not established; facet omission is reported as a conditional component/API edge.
No runtime reproduction is claimed for static source counterexamples.
Paper and current Mosaic implementation are researched by parent; findings, persistence, DSL and table/export paths by sibling agents.
application_checks: All proposed/unrun; no installation, build, typecheck, application tests, browser experiment, or benchmark.
